hero.title: Boiler Repair
hero.paragraph: No heating or hot water? Our Gas Safe engineers (No. 574111) cover Harrow, Pinner and Stanmore, and aim to reach you in 60 to 90 minutes for emergencies. Our vans carry common parts, so many faults are fixed on the first visit, at a price agreed before we start.

serviceDetails.title: How quickly can you get to me in Harrow?
paras: For emergencies, such as no heating in cold weather, we aim to reach homes in Harrow within 60 to 90 minutes, 7 days a week. For faults which can wait, we book a time to suit you. When you call, tell us your postcode, boiler make and any fault code, and we will give you an arrival time.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe engineer repairing a boiler in Harrow

serviceDetails.title: Quick checks before you call
paras: A few simple checks can sometimes get your heating back on, or help our engineer find the fault faster:
list: Note any fault code on the boiler display
Check the pressure gauge (around 1 to 1.5 bar when cold)
Check the thermostat and timer are on
Check the gas is on and other gas appliances work
Check the outside condensate pipe has not frozen
Press the reset button once only
serviceDetails.alt: Boiler pressure gauge showing low pressure

serviceDetails.title: Boiler faults we fix
paras: We repair all major brands, including Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal and Baxi, and fix common breakdown issues quickly:
list: No heating or no hot water
Boiler not firing up or locking out
Faulty pumps, fans, diverter valves and ignition parts
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer finding a boiler fault in a Harrow home

serviceDetails.title: Will I know the cost first?
paras: Yes. Before any repair, we explain the fault and give you a fixed price. Nothing goes ahead without your OK, and there are no surprise charges. If a part needs ordering, we tell you how long it will take and come back to fit it.
serviceDetails.alt: Fixed price boiler repair quote in Harrow

serviceDetails.title: Boiler repairs for Harrow landlords and letting agents
paras: When a tenant's boiler breaks down, landlords need it fixed fast. We already work with letting agents across Harrow, and can deal with your tenant directly to arrange access. You get a clear price before the repair, and a short report once the job is done. Need the yearly gas safety check too? We can do it on the same visit.
serviceDetails.alt: Boiler repair for a rented home in Harrow

serviceDetails.title: Repair or replace?
paras: We give a straight answer. If your boiler is under ten years old with a single worn part, a repair is usually best. If the repair costs more than the boiler is worth, or it keeps breaking down, a new boiler often costs less over time. A new combi boiler, fitted, usually costs between £1,800 and £3,500, and most fits take one day.
serviceDetails.alt: Deciding whether to repair or replace a boiler in Harrow

faqs.q: Why is my boiler losing pressure?
faqs.a: Common causes are a leak, a faulty pressure relief valve or a worn expansion vessel. Our engineer will find and fix the cause.

faqs.q: My boiler stopped in freezing weather. What should I do?
faqs.a: Check if the condensate pipe outside has frozen. Pour warm, not boiling, water over it and reset the boiler. If that fails, call us.

faqs.q: Do you repair boilers for landlords?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with landlords and letting agents across Harrow and can arrange access with tenants.
